concerns.text: T105's verification requires records 'conforming to contracts/experiment_log.schema.yaml', but that schema requires a numeric consensus_gap_score, which is only computed later by T109 ('writing scores back into the logs'). At T105's position in the execution order the verification criterion is unsatisfiable — a consumer (schema-valid log) depends on a producer (T109 scoring) that comes four tasks later. Either T105's verification must be scoped to the fields the runner actually produces (e.g., validate against the schema minus consensus_gap_score, or defer full schema validation to T112), or scoring must move into the runner.
